records.name: Perfect Shot
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Cell (Perfect) mentor training, Lesson 2. The user charges a green Ki blast at the fingers before firing; current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation describes a slow, mildly tracking projectile that can continue hitting after the user is free to move and reports about 9 hits. Exact startup, hitbox, damage, and tracking values remain unresolved.

records.name: Celestial Wave
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Stamina Ki Blast Evasive from PQ151, "Even Further Beyond." The user launches a blue energy wave upward; current skill documentation reports 7 hits and about 5% damage, with a nearby opponent being lifted by the wave. The acquisition record remains source-conflicted between Basic Reward and an older Ultimate-Finish presentation, so no exclusive gate is inferred.

records.name: Super Guard
records.mechanics_notes: Other Super that creates a blue energy barrier and grants damage immunity while held, continuously consuming Ki. Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists 100+ Ki use and identifies it as a starting skill for the close-up fighting-style choice / Skill Shop skill. Exact Ki drain rate, activation frames, and interruption behavior remain unresolved.

records.name: Spirit Bomb
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super learned through Goku mentor training. The user raises their hands and charges the projectile for roughly 2–3 seconds before a second input releases it; if the projectile misses, current skill documentation says it redirects like a boomerang for another chance to hit. Exact startup, tracking, damage, and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Afterimage
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Other Super and starting skill for the Mixed fighting-style choice. The user enters an afterimage pose; with correct timing, the move can evade an incoming attack and reposition the user behind a nearby opponent, while attacks from farther away can be evaded through the movement. Exact invulnerability timing and teleport distance remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Burst Reflection
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill obtained through the Shenron "I want a new Super Attack!" route. The user creates a lens-like barrier for about one second, receives protection/Super Armor while it is active, then fires a single Ki wave; current skill documentation reports about 10% damage. Exact frame and interaction behavior remain unresolved.

records.name: S.S. Deadly Bomber
records.mechanics_notes: 400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ115, "Extreme Battle with Android 13!" The user creates a Ki ball that heat-seeks the opponent; current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation reports 15 hits and about 30% damage. The maintained acquisition data treats it as a Basic Reward; exact drop probability and frame/hitbox details remain unresolved.

records.name: Thunder Flash
records.mechanics_notes: 300–600-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ146, "Zen-Ohs' Earthly Excursion." The user charges energy in a protected stance and then fires a straight beam; holding the input spends up to 300 additional Ki to extend the attack and increase its damage. Current skill documentation describes a 19-hit beam. Exact charge timing, damage scaling, and frame data remain unresolved.
